workflow.name: 0G TEE Inference
workflow.description: Run an LLM prompt inside a 0G Compute TEE and receive the response together with a TEE attestation root for on-chain verification. Powered by zhgg's 0g-tee-inference plugin. Returns response text, attestation root, USD cost estimate, latency, and provider receipt id.

prompt.description: Prompt text to send to the TEE-hosted model.

model.description: Optional model id. Defaults to qwen3.6-plus. Allowed: qwen3.6-plus, glm-5-fp8.

marketplace.description: Verifiable LLM inference inside a 0G TEE. Caller sends a prompt, receives the model response plus an attestation root anchoring the run on-chain. Useful for agents that need provable, tamper-evident model outputs (audits, on-chain governance memos, regulated workflows).

prompt.description: Prompt text to send to the TEE-hosted model.

attestation_root.description: TEE attestation root for on-chain verification.

cost_usd.description: Estimated USD cost of the call.
